note_superseded_totals: 'tiers' and 'totals' cover tier_a/b/c of the published corpus only. 'release_totals' covers every volume: those three plus staging, provenance-inputs, aux and manifests.
purpose: Durable <ANALYSIS_HOST>-local persistence of irreplaceable P2 measurement data (VM/job-tmp were ephemeral).

release_totals.note: Exact file-byte sums over the published archive (tier_a/b/c + staging + provenance-inputs + aux + manifests), EXCLUDING ARCHIVE_SHA256SUMS.txt -- that index is derived from every other file, so its own size is reported separately rather than folded into a total it covers. The tier_a/b/c figures elsewhere in this file describe those tiers only.

sha256sums: ARCHIVE_SHA256SUMS.txt (covers every other regular file in this archive; it cannot contain its own hash, and the archive holds no symlinks or special files)

local_result_refs.note: snapshot of top-level manifests/tables from p2_headtohead_detectors_20260825 + p2_supervised_arm_expanded_20260825 (excludes FINAL_3POOL_* live files)
